purpose: Turn observed cross-client trial failures into explicit design requirements, evaluation coverage and release gates.
evidence_rule: Observed means present in a preserved artefact. Session-reported means asserted by the trial output without a native provider export. Later-verified means reproduced from the repository or local client. Inferred means a proposed explanation and is never treated as an observation.

issues.title: OKF entrypoint and terminology were ambiguous to a new agent

evidence.summary: The agent first looked for a local package or MCP server and searched the web before treating the supplied descriptor as the bundle root.

issues.design_implication: A descriptor URL alone is navigable after discovery but is not a sufficient first-use instruction for agents unfamiliar with OKF.

remediations.action: Expose a compact descriptor/orientation MCP tool and resource that names scope, entrypoints, exact-record hydration and assurance boundaries.
Add a stable agent quickstart relation to the public descriptor and OKF Explorer.

issues.title: Large static shards obstruct exact-record hydration

evidence.summary: Several multi-megabyte resources were truncated and the target record could not be hydrated through a declared single-record route.
The client downloaded a 5.9 MB dataset shard and inspected only an initial slice.
Every canonical single record is below 65,536 bytes, so a bounded exact-record tool can avoid the shard-size failure.

issues.design_implication: Browser-oriented shards remain useful for static UI search, but agents need bounded search and exact-record retrieval contracts.

remediations.action: Provide deterministic metadata-only MCP search and get-record tools backed by the frozen corpus.
Return stable record IDs and source-qualified evidence pointers from search so hydration never depends on a guessed URL.
Publish canonical per-record static routes for clients that cannot use MCP.

issues.title: A convenient substitute can displace the requested dataset

evidence.summary: The requested CPIH record was located but not hydrated; a different Nomis record was used as a disclosed standards example.
The agent selected NM_66_1 from the first 800 lines as a worked example rather than showing that it was the best match for a user intent.
When the descriptor was unavailable, the report used an external ONS population example and clearly disclosed that substitution.

issues.design_implication: Selection must be a first-class evaluated decision: agents should see alternatives and decisive contrasts before settling on an exact record.

remediations.action: Make considered records, alternatives and contrast fields required answer fields.
Provide an MCP compare tool and enforce disclose-or-abstain behaviour when exact hydration fails.
Use the 12 confusable ONS gold queries as persona-linked journey samples and expand them with unseen confirmatory items.

issues.title: Standards evidence was vulnerable to compliance overclaiming

evidence.summary: The executive summary called the exercise autonomous compliance checking even though the same note retained the bundle's alignment-not-certification caveat.
The report generally kept OKF as an experimental complement to DCAT, PROV-O and government controls rather than a certification.

issues.design_implication: Caveats embedded in a record are necessary but not sufficient; critical assurance phrases need independent visible-answer review.

remediations.action: Keep alignment-not-certification and accuracy-not-evaluated in public gold and require an independent assessor to bind caveat evidence to visible answer spans.
Use typed claim statuses such as declared, mapped, evaluated, independently certified and not evaluated.

issues.title: Efficiency conclusions exceeded the captured telemetry

evidence.summary: The report called the traversal highly token-efficient without exact provider token telemetry or a comparison arm, after reporting about 5.95 MB downloaded.
Token totals were explicitly estimates and some returned bytes represented truncated prefixes rather than complete resources.
The runtime did not expose token usage or exact tool-call telemetry.

issues.design_implication: Efficiency is a comparative outcome, not an adjective inferred from one successful answer.

remediations.action: Capture elapsed time, tool calls, response bytes, complete-versus-partial byte scope, retries, exact-record hydration and provider tokens when natively reported.
Keep missing telemetry null and reject exact labels sourced from estimates.
Compare OKF, open-web and raw-API arms on the same tasks and host/model cells before making an efficiency claim.

issues.title: Client readiness and bundle failures were easy to conflate

evidence.summary: The browser extension was disconnected while separate fetch truncation and undeclared hydration failures occurred.
The Researcher environment could not retrieve the supplied descriptor but could use public web and enterprise sources.

issues.design_implication: A failed answer may be a readiness block, an access-arm violation, a client capability limit or a bundle defect; these require different denominators and remediations.

remediations.action: Probe installation, server connection, authentication and access policy separately before starting a task.
Exclude blocked readiness from answer-quality denominators and retain typed failure stages.

issues.title: Host, mode and resolved model identity were not consistently observable

evidence.summary: The artefact identifies M365 Researcher but says the model is unknown.
The model label and Cowork mode are session-reported; the host application is Claude Desktop.
Gemini 3.1 Pro (High) is reported by the trial output; the installed host is later verified as AGY 1.1.4.

issues.design_implication: Results belong to a host-mode-model combination and must not be reported as a pure model or client effect.

remediations.action: Record host product, surface, version, mode, model requested, model resolved and identity evidence source independently.
Use null for unexposed model identity and stratify reports by the complete observed combination.

issues.title: Generated DOCX evidence retained hidden metadata and non-portable layout

evidence.summary: The raw package contained hidden enterprise relationship locators and visible citation labels. The public derivative redacts them, while a LibreOffice render still shows source header/body collisions.
The raw package contained hidden enterprise relationship locators and visible citation labels. The public derivative redacts them, while the wide comparison table still spans pages.
The raw Claude DOCX contained MSIP/Purview custom-property metadata; the public derivative removes it and is bound to the private source hash.

issues.design_implication: A polished generated document is not automatically a durable evidence record.

remediations.action: Retain raw Office packages privately by hash and publish only validated sanitized derivatives with an explicit redaction log.
Require package inspection, an all-page rendered-document visual check and a hash-bound technical public-release review before publication.

issues.title: MCP deployment differs materially by client surface

evidence.summary: AGY can load a workspace stdio server. Claude Cowork can use plugins or local MCP in an existing local Desktop session subject to configuration and MDM policy, but local MCP does not run in remote sessions. M365 Researcher requires an admin-governed federated connector and a user-authenticated source connection.

issues.design_implication: One copied local JSON configuration cannot create a comparable MCP arm across command-line, local desktop, remote research and enterprise browser execution modes.

remediations.action: Ship a dependency-free local stdio broker and a repo-scoped AGY configuration.
Package the broker as a Claude Desktop extension for local chat trials.

Deploy the same read-only tool contract at an authenticated Microsoft-reachable HTTPS MCP endpoint for M365 federated-connector trials, then test protocol compatibility instead of assuming that the current local broker or a particular remote transport is sufficient.

issues.title: ONS-specific personas and journeys were implicit rather than testable

evidence.summary: The repository had confusable gold queries and smoke tasks, while explicit personas existed only in sibling OKF Explorer and MCP-Geo material.

issues.design_implication: A task list alone cannot show whose decision is improved, which errors matter to them, or whether the suite covers the discovery lifecycle.

remediations.action: Cross-link every persona, journey, smoke task and ONS gold query in a machine-validated manifest.
Have ONS subject-matter experts review persona coverage and author at least 50 unseen confirmatory questions.

release_gates.rule: Every issue evidence path exists and every observation_id is declared in the research or evaluation evidence register.
Every issue maps to at least one journey and one public smoke task.
Every critical issue has at least one P0 remediation and a typed failure code.

Every public Office artifact MUST be a sanitized derivative listed in research/manifest.json with its public hash, private source hash and redaction log; it MUST pass package inspection and an all-page rendered-document review under a hash-bound technical public-release review, and the raw Office package MUST be excluded from the repository.
